Wording: Is multi-factor authentication enforced for all vendor administrator and privileged accounts that can reach our data or systems?
Answer choices: All privileged accounts = 0 | Some privileged accounts = 3 | None = 4
Evidence artifact and period: MFA policy plus an export of privileged accounts showing MFA status, dated within the last 90 days
Reviewer acceptance criteria: Export lists every privileged account and shows MFA enabled for 100 percent; any exception has a named approver and expiry date

Wording: Does the vendor review who has access to our data and systems at least every 6 months?
Answer choices: At least quarterly = 0 | Twice yearly = 1 | Annually = 2 | Ad hoc or never = 4
Evidence artifact and period: Most recent access review record showing reviewer, review date and removals, within the last 12 months
Reviewer acceptance criteria: Record names the reviewer, covers all systems holding our data, and shows removals or confirmation actioned

Wording: Are accounts of staff who leave or change role disabled within 1 business day?
Answer choices: Within 1 business day, automated = 0 | Within 1 business day, manual = 1 | Within 5 business days = 2 | No defined timeframe = 4
Evidence artifact and period: Leaver procedure plus a sample of 5 recent leavers with account disable timestamps, from the last 6 months
Reviewer acceptance criteria: Procedure states the timeframe; at least 4 of 5 sampled accounts were disabled within the stated time

Wording: Is vendor staff access to our data limited to those who need it, with privileged access approved and logged?
Answer choices: Enforced and logged = 0 | Enforced, not logged = 2 | Partly enforced = 3 | Not enforced = 4
Evidence artifact and period: Access control policy plus a privileged access log extract covering the last 90 days
Reviewer acceptance criteria: Policy requires approval for privileged access; log shows named users, approvals and timestamps

Wording: Is regulated or confidential customer data encrypted at rest with a recognised strong algorithm?
Answer choices: All data at rest encrypted = 0 | Some data encrypted = 3 | Not encrypted = 4
Evidence artifact and period: Encryption configuration export or architecture document stating algorithm and key management, dated within the last 12 months
Reviewer acceptance criteria: Covers every store holding our data; algorithm is recognised and strong (for example AES-256); keys managed separately from data

Wording: Is data encrypted in transit using current TLS on all connections to our data?
Answer choices: TLS 1.2 or higher on all connections = 0 | Mostly encrypted = 2 | Unencrypted connections exist = 4
Evidence artifact and period: External TLS scan report or configuration extract, dated within the last 90 days
Reviewer acceptance criteria: Scan shows no endpoint holding our data accepts unencrypted or deprecated protocol versions

Wording: Does the vendor delete or return our data within a defined period at contract end and confirm it in writing?
Answer choices: Defined and evidenced = 0 | Defined, not evidenced = 2 | Not defined = 4
Evidence artifact and period: Data retention and deletion policy plus a deletion certificate from a contract end in the last 12 months
Reviewer acceptance criteria: Policy states the deletion period; certificate names the data, date and method

Wording: Is our data stored and processed only in locations agreed with us?
Answer choices: Agreed locations only = 0 | Other locations with notice = 2 | Unknown or unrestricted = 4
Evidence artifact and period: Data location statement listing hosting regions, signed or dated within the last 12 months
Reviewer acceptance criteria: Every location is named and matches the contract or approved list

Wording: Will the vendor notify us of a security incident affecting our data within 72 hours?
Answer choices: Within 24 hours = 0 | Within 72 hours = 1 | Longer than 72 hours = 3 | No commitment = 4
Evidence artifact and period: Contract clause or incident notification procedure, current version
Reviewer acceptance criteria: Document states a maximum notification time of 72 hours or less and names the contact route

Wording: Has the vendor tested its incident response plan in the last 12 months?
Answer choices: Tested within 12 months with report = 0 | Tested over 12 months ago = 2 | Documented, not tested = 3 | No plan = 4
Evidence artifact and period: Exercise or test report with date, scenario and actions, within the last 12 months
Reviewer acceptance criteria: Report shows a realistic scenario, participants, date and tracked improvement actions

Wording: Are logs for systems holding our data kept for at least 12 months and monitored for suspicious activity?
Answer choices: Kept 12 months and monitored 24 hours a day = 0 | Kept and monitored in business hours = 1 | Kept, not monitored = 3 | Not kept = 4
Evidence artifact and period: Logging policy plus a monitoring alert sample or configuration extract, dated within the last 90 days
Reviewer acceptance criteria: Policy states retention of 12 months or more; sample shows alerts reviewed and actioned

Wording: Has the vendor had a security incident affecting customers in the last 24 months, and were customers told?
Answer choices: No incident = 0 | Incident, notified on time, lessons recorded = 1 | Incident, notified late = 3 | Not disclosed or refused to answer = 4
Evidence artifact and period: Incident register extract or statement signed by the named security officer covering the last 24 months
Reviewer acceptance criteria: Statement is signed and dated, covers the full 24 months, and lists dates and notification outcomes

Wording: Has the vendor tested recovery of the service we use within the agreed recovery time in the last 12 months?
Answer choices: Tested, objectives met = 0 | Tested, objectives missed = 2 | Defined, not tested = 3 | No objectives defined = 4
Evidence artifact and period: Recovery test report showing recovery time and recovery point objectives and results, within the last 12 months
Reviewer acceptance criteria: Report covers the service we use, states objectives and actual results, and records follow-up for any miss

Wording: Are backups taken at least daily, encrypted, and restored in tests?
Answer choices: Daily, encrypted, restore tested = 0 | Daily, restore not tested = 2 | Less than daily = 3 | No backups = 4
Evidence artifact and period: Backup policy plus a restore test log, within the last 12 months
Reviewer acceptance criteria: Policy states daily frequency and encryption; log shows a successful restore with date

Wording: Does the vendor have an approved business continuity plan for the service, reviewed every year?
Answer choices: Approved, reviewed in last 12 months = 0 | Approved, older review = 2 | Draft only = 3 | No plan = 4
Evidence artifact and period: Plan approval page showing version, approver and review date, within the last 12 months
Reviewer acceptance criteria: Plan covers the service we use and shows management approval

Wording: Is the service hosted across at least two sites or zones with failover?
Answer choices: Multi-site, failover tested = 0 | Multi-site, untested = 2 | Single site with backup = 3 | Single site, no failover = 4
Evidence artifact and period: Architecture diagram plus failover test record, within the last 12 months
Reviewer acceptance criteria: Diagram shows two or more sites; record shows a failover test with date and result

Wording: Does the vendor keep a current list of subcontractors that handle our data or support our service, and give us notice before adding one?
Answer choices: Complete list and prior notice = 0 | List, no notice = 2 | Partial list = 3 | No list = 4
Evidence artifact and period: Current subcontractor register (name, service, data access) plus the contract clause on prior notice, dated within the last 12 months
Reviewer acceptance criteria: Register is complete and current; clause requires notice before any new subcontractor is used

Wording: Does the vendor require its subcontractors to meet the same security requirements and check that they do?
Answer choices: Required and verified = 0 | Required, not verified = 2 | Partly required = 3 | Not required = 4
Evidence artifact and period: Security clauses from the two most recent subcontractor contracts plus the latest verification record, within the last 12 months
Reviewer acceptance criteria: Clauses cover access, data protection and incident notification; verification record is dated and signed

Wording: Does the vendor assess the security of its critical subcontractors at least every year?
Answer choices: Annual assessment = 0 | Every 2 years = 2 | At onboarding only = 3 | Never = 4
Evidence artifact and period: Most recent assessment report for the highest-risk subcontractor, within the last 12 months
Reviewer acceptance criteria: Report names the subcontractor, scope, date, findings and follow-up

Wording: Does the vendor have a plan to replace a subcontractor that fails or is withdrawn?
Answer choices: Documented and tested = 0 | Documented, untested = 2 | Informal = 3 | None = 4
Evidence artifact and period: Subcontractor exit or substitution plan with approval date, within the last 12 months
Reviewer acceptance criteria: Plan names the critical subcontractors, the fallback and the owner

Wording: Does the vendor have a management-approved information security policy and a named security owner, reviewed every year?
Answer choices: Approved, owner named, reviewed in last 12 months = 0 | Approved, older review = 2 | Draft only = 3 | None = 4
Evidence artifact and period: Policy cover page showing approver, version and review date, plus the named security owner, within the last 12 months
Reviewer acceptance criteria: Policy is approved by management and reviewed in the last 12 months; owner is named by role

Wording: Does the vendor hold current independent security assurance (for example a SOC 2 Type II report or ISO/IEC 27001 certificate) covering the service we use?
Answer choices: Current and covers our service = 0 | Current, different scope = 2 | Expired = 3 | None = 4
Evidence artifact and period: Report or certificate with issue date, period covered and scope statement, issued within the last 12 months
Reviewer acceptance criteria: Scope includes the service we use; period is current; any qualified opinion or exception is explained

Wording: Do all vendor staff complete security awareness training every year?
Answer choices: At least 95 percent completed = 0 | 80 to 94 percent = 2 | Below 80 percent = 3 | No training = 4
Evidence artifact and period: Training completion report for the last 12 months
Reviewer acceptance criteria: Report shows completion rate across all staff with access to our data

Wording: Does the vendor commission an independent penetration test at least every year and track fixes?
Answer choices: Annual test, high findings fixed = 0 | Annual test, findings open over 90 days = 2 | Last test over 12 months ago = 3 | No test = 4
Evidence artifact and period: Penetration test summary showing date, scope and findings status, within the last 12 months
Reviewer acceptance criteria: Test covers the service we use, is independent, and high findings are closed or have dated plans
